items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: No, I asked him whether he related to Gene Hall, this guy showed you.

ctx.x: Rennie Hall, was he a New Orleans band? Right, Born in Red, right there. Is he related to any other Hall that we've been going around?

No, I asked him whether he related to Gene Hall, this guy showed you. He said, no, well Gene comes from Mississippi. I don't know. He said no, but he don't know. I looked at his mother. I used to think it was his mother, but it wasn't his mother. He was adopted. See, he was an adopted child. Why? He was an adopted child. But she, not so long ago, she was real low and she asked me if I was getting contact or Rennie Hall, and I did. She died. He came down. She was buried and everything. See, that's not so long ago,…
I don't think he was related to Edmond Hall or Clarence Hall or anything.
